ModMetaData.name: 联合轻工打印机脚底输出 / UFLI Drop Product At Feet
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiverMa
ModMetaData.description:
为「联合轻工家具拓展」的联合全息打印机添加产物输出开关。默认开启：产物直接以 ThingPlaceMode.Near 刷在打印机 InteractionCell 附近，不再优先瞬移到全图货架或储存区；关闭后恢复 UFLI 原始投递逻辑。可在本补丁的 Mod 设置中修改，也可选中打印机后点击底部开关；设置跨存档持久化保存。
Adds a persistent output-mode toggle for UFLI's holographic printer. Enabled by default: products are placed near the printer's InteractionCell instead of first teleporting to map-wide shelves or storage zones. Disable it to restore UFLI's original delivery logic. Use this patch's Mod settings or the printer's bottom toggle gizmo; the setting persists across saves.
